target: doctor.sh and forge.sh check — a malformed .agentic/config.json yields a warn saying the forge config was ignored
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_gh auth_status 0 "Logged in"
unset FORGE FORGE_URL FORGE_REMOTE FORGE_TOKEN GITLAB_TOKEN
fx_remote https://gitlab.example.test/grp/proj.git
export FORGE_TOKEN=glpat-FAKE-not-a-real-token-0001
fx_http "GET /api/v4/user" 200 '{"username":"x"}'
mkdir -p .agentic; printf '{not json' > .agentic/config.json
fx_run check; fx_show check
printf '%s\n' "$FX_OUT" | grep -E $'^warn\t' | grep -qi 'config.*ignored\|ignored.*config' && echo check_warn=yes || echo check_warn=no
fx_doctor
printf '%s\n' "$FX_SEC" | grep -F '[WARN]' | grep -qi 'config.*ignored\|ignored.*config' && echo doctor_warn=yes || echo doctor_warn=no
fx_done
